finalText:
Build's clean now: 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler's new options shape:
1. `src/core/options.js` — read `options.retries` (old key), bundler now sends `retryCount`. Fixed.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — threw on `undefined` flags instead of treating unset as disabled. Fixed to default to `false`.

The rest was harmless deprecation/dedupe noise from the version bump — left alone since it's not breaking anything.

Next: run your real test suite to confirm nothing else relied on the old `retries` key.
